ownership_policy.Shared: stable shared identity with explicit ChessRogueNous reachability
ownership_policy.EvidenceOnly: excluded row retained only to prove the content boundary
ownership_policy.fail_closed: RogueDLC is a shared framework; only explicit ChessRogueNous selectors, references or inherited shared-pool proofs grant reachability

denominator_policy.source_obligation: counts freeze exact source and inherited stable-ID obligations; normalized child rows may expand but cannot remove an obligation
denominator_policy.topology_edges: released chessboard configs expose nodes/coordinates/events but no edge list; deterministic edge semantics are a B4 ProjectPolicy contract, not invented ExactStructured rows
denominator_policy.encounters: room bindings and displayed boss identities are the frozen source obligations; P2-B5 expands StageConfig waves/enemy slots with exact-once parent references
denominator_policy.fixture_families: the 18 family IDs are a non-shrinking minimum; multiple fixtures may satisfy one family

profiles.membership_basis: One project profile for the Version 4.4 ChessRogueNous activity boundary.

entry_points.membership_basis: The resident activity, DLC entrance and common title rows whose sub-mode is ChessRogueNous.

guide_areas.membership_basis: ChessRogueNous area rows outside the five Formal difficulties.

formal_difficulties.membership_basis: The five ChessRogueNous Formal area rows, Difficulty_1 through Difficulty_5.

difficulty_segments.membership_basis: Shared RogueDLCDifficulty rows directly referenced by ChessRogueNous areas.

conundrum_levels.membership_basis: All released RogueNous attribute and additional difficulty definitions.

planes.membership_basis: Shared DLC layer rows directly referenced by ChessRogueNous areas.

chessboards.membership_basis: Shared DLC chessboard rows whose configuration path is in MapRepo160/RogueNous.

map_columns.membership_basis: Distinct authored PosX columns within every reachable RogueNous chessboard.

map_nodes.membership_basis: Every authored RogueChestGridItemMap entry in reachable RogueNous chessboards.

map_events.membership_basis: Every authored RogueChestEventMap entry in reachable RogueNous chessboards.

block_create_rules.membership_basis: Every authored RogueBlockCreateGroupList row in reachable RogueNous chessboards.

domains.membership_basis: Distinct BlockType values reachable from RogueNous nodes or block-create rules.

beacons.membership_basis: Distinct nonzero MarkCreateRandomList TypeID values reachable from RogueNous boards.

room_bindings.membership_basis: All released ChessRogueNous room-to-section membership rows.

adventure_outcomes.membership_basis: Shared abstract Adventure definitions whose room is reachable in RogueNous.

boss_choices.membership_basis: Distinct displayed boss/enemy identities referenced by ChessRogueNous areas.

cognition_ranges.membership_basis: All released RogueNous area cognition ranges.

secret_conditions.membership_basis: All RogueNous sub-story rows retained only for mechanical area/cognition thresholds.

mode_constants.membership_basis: All released common RogueNous constants; client-only presentation constants are excluded.

dice_categories.membership_basis: All released RogueNous dice branch tags.

dice_definitions.membership_basis: All released RogueNous custom dice branches.

dice_path_values.membership_basis: Every dice-branch and selected-Path value binding.

dice_slots.membership_basis: All six released RogueNous dice slots.

knowledge_bindings.membership_basis: Dice surfaces tagged Mark, the released structured locator for Knowledge interactions.

neural_network_nodes.membership_basis: All released RogueNous talent nodes; reward-only fields remain excluded downstream.

paths.membership_basis: All nine Goal 03 stable Path identities are selectable by RogueNousAeon.

resonances.membership_basis: All 36 Goal 03 stable Resonance/Formation identities are shared and reachable.

blessings.membership_basis: All 162 Goal 03 stable Blessing identities are shared and reachable.

blessing_levels.membership_basis: Both authored levels of every reachable shared Blessing.

path_boosts.membership_basis: One RogueNous mode-entry Path boost for each selectable Aeon.

resonance_extrapolations.membership_basis: Every buff in RogueNous normal/enhanced BattleEvent groups for all nine Paths.

resonance_interplays.membership_basis: All released RogueNous main/sub-Aeon interplay bindings.

trailblaze_bonuses.membership_basis: Gold and Gears-owned RogueBonus IDs 201 through 205.

curios.membership_basis: All handbook Curios whose mode membership includes type 160 (Gold and Gears).

curio_states.membership_basis: Exactly one 3000-series Gold and Gears mode copy for every reachable Curio.

occurrences.membership_basis: All handbook Occurrences whose mode membership includes type 160.

occurrence_variants.membership_basis: Distinct 300000-series NPC progress variants reachable from type-160 handbooks.

shared_services.membership_basis: The 15 non-bonus service definitions inherited from the Goal 03 reference pack.

semantic_fixture_families.membership_basis: Minimum distinct semantic families; B4 freezes fixture shape and later batches may add cases without shrinking these obligations.
